title: 100 foreigners nabbed in Zamboanga POGO hubs to be flown to Manila
summary: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – At least 100 foreign nationals, mostly Chinese, apprehended during the raids on Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) hubs will be transported to Manila from…

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – At least 100 foreign nationals, mostly Chinese, apprehended during the raids on Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) hubs will be transported to Manila from the Pagadian City Airport here on Monday morning on board a C-130 military aircraft. The foreigners are part of the over 200 apprehended during the operations against POGO hubs in Alicia and Siay towns in Zamboanga Sibugay last October 2. They would be the second batch brought to Manila following the raids spearheaded by the Bureau of Immigration and the National Bureau of Investigation.
